_doc: His medical books (#819; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/doctor/): a pile of three lying on a table or a desk's top, the army's big quarto under his visiting list. The standard American texts a country doctor of 1882 owned: Medical & Surgical History Of The War (Surg. Genl.); The Physician Himself (Cathell); Physician'S Visiting List (a year's volume). Most in law sheep (tan sheepskin with a red and a black label lettered in gilt, the trade binding of medical books into the 1880s), some in publishers' cloth, a few in calf. Each book a member (wood `paper`: ~1.5 kg an octavo): it burns, a ball goes through it, the row comes down with its shelf. Drawn from glb:medical_books, every face printed on its own sheet (tools/blender/props/doctor_d3.py: Pillow, as the bottles' labels). Written by tools/props/doctor.py.
